components.name: Chart/Scatter
components.description: Relationship between two numeric variables (income vs spend, risk vs return). Default: one point per item; Bubble: size = a third variable, up to 2 groups, layer opacity 60%; Trend line: dashed regression with its confidence band. Never imply causation — say “correlates”. React: <ScatterChart data x y size? group? trend? />

Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
Both axes labelled with units; start at 0 only if 0 is meaningful.
Overplotting: lower opacity or switch to a density view above ~1 000 points.
Say “correlates”, never “causes”.
Spec
Library-neutral contract — maps to Recharts, ECharts, D3, Visx, SwiftUI Charts or Compose.
